# MIT App Inventor

> > MIT App Inventor is a visual block-based platform for creating mobile applications for iOS and Android, designed to make programming accessible to learners of all ages.

MIT App Inventor is an open-source educational platform developed at MIT that enables users to build functional mobile apps using drag-and-drop visual blocks instead of traditional code. The platform emphasizes accessibility, creative expression, and computational thinking while supporting advanced topics like artificial intelligence, data science, and machine learning.

## Key Topics

- Block-based programming
- Mobile app development
- Visual programming
- Android and iOS
- Artificial intelligence
- Machine learning
- Data science
- Educational platform
- Computational thinking

- Coding education
- Hour of Code
- AI curriculum
- Youth empowerment
- Workshops and events

## Getting Started

- [MIT App Inventor](https://appinventor.mit.edu): MIT App Inventor homepage: visual block-based platform for mobile app development
- [Jump In and Start Programming!](https://appinventor.mit.edu/explore/ai2/beginner-videos): Beginner video tutorials for block-based iOS and Android app development
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://appinventor.mit.edu/FAQ): FAQ covering getting started, requirements, and common questions about App Inventor
- [Hour of Code with MIT App Inventor](https://appinventor.mit.edu/explore/hour-of-code): Hour of Code beginner tutorial for block-based mobile app development

## Learning & Tutorials

- [Our Tutorials!](https://appinventor.mit.edu/explore/ai2/tutorials): Comprehensive tutorials from beginner to advanced mobile app and AI projects
- [Make iPhone Apps with App Inventor!](https://appinventor.mit.edu/ios_tips): Guide for building iPhone and iPad apps with MIT App Inventor iOS companion
- [Books on App Inventor Coding](https://appinventor.mit.edu/explore/books): Free educational books and learning resources for MIT App Inventor coding

## Education & Curriculum

- [Teach with App Inventor](https://appinventor.mit.edu/explore/teach): Teacher resources, curriculum guides, and classroom setup for App Inventor education
- [Artificial Intelligence with MIT App Inventor](https://appinventor.mit.edu/explore/ai-with-mit-app-inventor): AI and machine learning curriculum units including image classification and ethics
- [Data Science](https://appinventor.mit.edu/explore/ai2/data_science_unit): Data science curriculum covering surveys, sensors, visualization, and environmental data

## Community & Events

- [Events](https://appinventor.mit.edu/explore/events): Upcoming workshops, hackathons, and professional development events
- [Stories from the Field](https://appinventor.mit.edu/explore/stories): User case studies and success stories from MIT App Inventor community globally
- [Team Blog](https://appinventor.mit.edu/explore/blog): MIT App Inventor team blog covering workshops, updates, and community outreach
- [News](https://appinventor.mit.edu/explore/news): News, awards, and updates about MIT App Inventor education and initiatives
